name: Prawn & pea risotto
steps: Soften the onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add the arborio rice and stir for a minute to coat.
Add the warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed.
When the rice is nearly tender, stir in the prawns and peas.
Cook until the prawns are pink and the rice is creamy.
Stir through the parmesan and serve.
